description: This file is a shell script containing test cases for Git worktree features. It defines setup steps, assertions, and validations related to references, reflogs, and worktree management in Git.

methods.name: test_commit
methods.description: Creates a new commit, with optional arguments defining scope or directory.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case with a description, runs commands, and checks for success.

methods.name: test_cmp_rev
methods.description: Compares two revisions or references for equality.

methods.name: test_when_finished
methods.description: Registers cleanup commands to run after tests complete.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the end of the test script.
